description: Source code for Kubernetes admission plugin CEL condition evaluation, including compilation and evaluation of CEL expressions, conversion utilities, and admission request creation.

classes.name: conditionCompiler
classes.description: Implements the ConditionCompiler interface for compiling CEL expressions.

classes.name: condition
classes.description: Implements the ConditionEvaluator interface, representing a compiled CEL condition.

methods.name: NewConditionCompiler
methods.description: Creates a new conditionCompiler with the given environment.

methods.name: CompileCondition
methods.description: Compiles CEL expressions into a ConditionEvaluator.

methods.name: NewCondition
methods.description: Creates a new condition instance with compilation results.

methods.name: convertObjectToUnstructured
methods.description: Converts a generic object to an unstructured.Unstructured.

methods.name: objectToResolveVal
methods.description: Converts a runtime.Object to an interface{} for resolution.

methods.name: ForInput
methods.description: Evaluates compiled CEL expressions with given inputs and context.

methods.name: CreateAdmissionRequest
methods.description: Constructs an admission.v1.AdmissionRequest from attributes and GVR/GVK.

methods.name: CreateNamespaceObject
methods.description: Creates a namespace object suitable for CEL evaluation.

methods.name: CompilationErrors
methods.description: Returns a list of errors from the compilation process.
